headline: Sony brings QSSR AI upscaling to the standard PS5
summary: Sony is bringing a new AI upscaling technology, Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), to the standard PS5, developed through its Project Amethyst work with AMD. Engadget reports Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei will be the first games to support it.

claims.statement: Sony is bringing a new AI upscaling technology, Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), to the standard PS5.

sources.quote: The new tech, called Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), is a "new performance tier of AI upscaling" that's a result of Sony's Project Amethyst work with AMD
